name: When should I expand my bathroom instead of just replacing finishes?

mainEntity.name: When should I expand my bathroom instead of just replacing finishes?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider expanding if your current layout causes daily congestion, lacks practical storage, or cannot accommodate desired features like a double vanity or a separate walk-in shower. Many homeowners also decide to expand when planning for long-term accessibility, such as converting a cramped tub area into a zero-threshold shower with wider clearance. Assessing how your household uses the space every morning helps determine if a cosmetic remodel will suffice or if genuine structural enlargement is needed to improve comfort.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expand if you need structural space for double vanities, larger walk-in showers, better storage, or improved accessibility that a cosmetic remodel cannot deliver.
